Adjustment ” shall mean 0.10%. “ Federal Funds Effective Rate ” shall mean, for any day, the weighted
average (rounded upward, if necessary, to the next 1/100 of 1%) of the rates on overnight Federal funds transactions with members of the Federal Reserve System, as published on the next succeeding Business Day by the Federal Reserve Bank of New
York, or, if such rate is not so published for any day which is a Business Day, the average (rounded upward, if necessary, to the next 1/100 of 1%) of the quotations for the day of such transactions received by the Lender from three Federal funds

# PRIVATE CREDIT INVESTMENT MEMORANDUM

**WESTLAKE CHEMICAL OPCO LP - REVOLVING CREDIT FACILITY AMENDMENT**

---

## 1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

**Date of Agreement:** July 12, 2022

**Borrower/Company Overview:** Westlake Chemical OpCo LP, a Delaware limited partnership operating as the borrowing entity within the Westlake Chemical corporate structure.

**Transaction Description:** Second Amendment to an existing Amended and Restated Senior Unsecured Revolving Credit Agreement. The transaction involves related-party lending, with Westlake Polymers LLC serving as administrative agent and both Westlake Polymers LLC and Westlake Longview Corporation acting as lenders. This represents an intra-company financing arrangement within the broader Westlake Chemical organization.

**Purpose of Financing:** The amendment serves to extend the maturity date of the existing revolving credit facility and transition the interest rate mechanism from LIBOR to SOFR, in accordance with benchmark rate reforms.

**Company Background and Context:** Westlake Chemical OpCo LP operates within the Westlake Chemical corporate family, a chemical manufacturing organization. The original credit agreement was established on June 1, 2017, with a prior amendment executed on September 25, 2018, indicating an established credit relationship spanning multiple years.

---

## 2. INVESTMENT HIGHLIGHTS & RISKS

### Key Strengths / Credit Positives:
• **Related-party structure** provides aligned interests and reduced counterparty risk within the Westlake Chemical organization
• **Established credit relationship** dating back to 2017 with successful amendment history
• **Senior unsecured positioning** in the capital structure
• **Maturity extension** to July 12, 2027 provides 5-year term certainty
• **Modern benchmark transition** from LIBOR to SOFR demonstrates proactive rate management
• **Flexible rate structure** with both SOFR and Alternate Base Rate options

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
• **Concentration risk** - Related-party lending structure concentrates credit exposure within single corporate family
• **Interest rate risk** - Variable rate structure exposes borrower to rate volatility, though mitigated by rate floor protections (SOFR Successor Rate cannot be less than zero)
• **Benchmark transition risk** - SOFR implementation may create operational complexities, though mitigated by comprehensive fallback provisions and alternative rate mechanisms
• **Limited diversification** - Intra-company arrangement lacks third-party validation of credit terms and market pricing
